research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sila Nanotechnologies Inc. is focused on advancing lithium-ion battery technology with innovations in electrode and electrolyte compositions. They are developing multi-shell structures for battery active materials, high-capacity anodes, and electrolytes tailored for improved performance. Their research includes the stabilization of Li-ion battery anodes using hydrofluoric acid neutralizing agents, metal sulfide composite materials, and methods for increasing metal content in batteries. They are also exploring solid-state electrolytes for enhanced safety and performance, as well as core-shell composites for electrodes. Each R&D effort aims to enhance energy density, safety, and longevity of batteries for electric vehicles.

overview_description.description:
Sila is a battery materials company that manufactures energy-density lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles. It works directly with consumer electronics and automotive OEMs to help accelerate product roadmaps and partners with battery manufacturers' commercial cell production.

The company was founded in 2011 and headquartered in California, United States.
